# @three-ws/pose

> Deterministic, named pose seeds for rigged 3D avatars. Map a natural-language prompt to a stable seed + full Euler joint-rotation map from the three.ws pose-studio preset library.

@three-ws/pose is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/pose`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-pose/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-pose/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-pose/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-pose/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
